senses.definition: (also Kt יעישׁ) n.pr.m. (prob. he comes to help, NöZMG xl (1886), 168; = Arabic n.pr.div. يَغُوثُ, WeSkizzen iii, 171; Heid. 2, 146 RSK 218 (cf. Sem i. 43) Nöl.c., yet against this 𝔊 Ιεους (i.e. ع; not Ιαγους, غ), and יְ (not יָ), LagM ii. 77; BN 133 BuhlEdom. 48 f.);—
son of Esau Gn 36:5, 14 (both Kt יעישׁ), v 18 1 Ch 1:35.
a Levite 1 Ch 23:10, 11.
son of Rehoboam 2 Ch 11:19.—יוֹעָשׁ v. supr., p. 222 b.
